notes.title: Moor Rail – Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Moor Rail – Update Announcement[/p][p]Hello. This is the [i]Moor Rail[/i] development team.[/p][p]In the latest update, we have improved overall flow, usability, and balance of the game. We also reflected player feedback to provide clearer guidance and made various system adjustments.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Update Details[/h3][list][*][p]Stage data has been modified.[/p][/*][*][p]Supplemental explanations have been added in the tutorial (double jump, dash, defeat).[/p][/*][*][p]Wave indicators have been implemented for each wave section.[/p][/*][*][p]Effects for wind and mercenaries have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Some mercenaries have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Train equip system has been revised (some trains can be equipped infinitely, others only once).[/p][/*][*][p]Spawn item probabilities have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]In the shop, it is now clearly indicated whether each train consumes fuel or is cooldown-based.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs that occurred during play have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We are always striving to make the game more fun and polished, and we are putting our best effort into preparing for the official release.
Thank you for continuing to support [i]Moor Rail[/i]. We look forward to bringing you more news and improvements.[/p][p]Regards,
— [i]Moor Rail[/i] Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Moor Rail Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Moor Rail Major Update Announcement[/h3][p]Hello players,
Through [b]PLAYX4 and Steam Next Fest[/b], we gathered valuable feedback and closely observed how players enjoy the game. Based on this, we worked hard to improve many aspects and add new content. This update is the result of that effort, and we will continue to evolve Moor Rail with care and dedication.[/p][p]Main Update Highlights[/p][list][*][p][b]Trains Added[/b]: Normal trains increased from 5 to 13, new turret train “Thunderous Train” (currently level 1, will expand to level 6 in the future)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Items Expanded[/b]: From 70 to 150, focusing on defense and support for trains[/p][/*][*][p][b]Codex System[/b]: View monster, item, and story information in the Training Grounds[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Features[/b]: Dash (L-Shift), double jump, revival possible with “Defibrillator” item[/p][/*][*][p][b]Defeat Conditions[/b]: Added defeat if the engine train is destroyed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mercenary Improvements[/b]: Engineer auto-repairs trains, Warrior tracks targets to the end[/p][/*][*][p][b]Train Departure System[/b]: Departure possible with fuel train even if empty trains exist[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story Update[/b]: Cute Cherry illustration added[/p][/*][*][p][b]Other Improvements[/b]: Station transitions polished, vault visuals in special stages updated[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🔧 [Hotfix Update – Patch Notes]
notes.content:
🔧 [Hotfix Update – Patch Notes]
Hello, this is the Moor Rail Development Team.
Thank you so much to all players for your support and feedback.

We’ve just released a hotfix to address key issues and improve gameplay balance.
The following changes are now live:

📌 Fixed & Adjusted
Fixed a bug where some stages couldn’t be cleared

Reduced monster attack power and train slow effects

Buffed the Communication Room feature

Adjusted gold cost for purchasing items

and are fully committed to improving the game with each update.

Thank you again for playing Moor Rail – your continued support means the world to us.

notes.title: Hotfix Update for Moorrail

Hello,
This is the development team of Moorrail.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused during gameplay.
We have released a hotfix update to address the following issues:

Patch Notes
Fixed error in Stage 1-4 (Monster Elimination)

Resolved an issue where an error occurred in Stage 1, preventing progress.
